notes:
- Stitch Edit lets you move, insert, and delete cover needle points on eligible Run, Satin, Tatami, and imported machine designs. Regenerate Stitches restores shape-based stitches. Saved needle edits to generated objects use project format 54.
- Manual Needle Stitches and open Motif Run are available in More Tools. Lettering on Path now opens for both open and closed paths.
- Multi-hooping now opens from Design and keeps the selected stitch engine across whole-object hooping exports.
- Updated Tatami needle patterns and previews, Satin corners and Auto Jump, Run reinforcement, and fill routing around holes and angled sections.
- Digitizing Lab has a matching release on its separate channel.
